topic: How do shadowed Rician parameters (m, b, ω) affect link budget calculations considering interference fluctuations at both terrestrial relay and destination nodes?
consensus_response: Shadowed Rician (SR) parameters (m, b, ω) significantly impact link budget calculations by introducing uncertainty in signal strength due to fading. The Nakagami parameter (m) affects the severity of fading, while the scatter parameter (b0) influences the spread of the faded signal. The shadowing parameter (ω) determines the power loss due to shadowing. Interference fluctuations at both terrestrial relay and destination nodes further exacerbate these effects, requiring adaptive resource allocation strategies to mitigate their impact on system performance.
